summary:
Oct 7,  


Thank you for your letter of Oct 19. Here follows the answers as best I can 

give them. 

CANTATA 140, half of which was published by F&SF was published in its entirety by Ace (blech) as THE CRACK IN SPACE. I objected to that title, but 
Ace listens to no one except the cash register. As to TIME PAWN, it was a short novel in TWS only back in ’54, and I use the title on my brag sheets for reasons I forget; maybe I like the title, and it is very long. Much of it was incorporated in DR. FUTURITY, so I guess I am sort of cheating. A HANDFUL OF DARKNESS was never published in the U.S. Belmont published the reprint of TIME OUT OF JOINT. Re your paragraph #4: as I say DR. FUTURITY was developed out of TIME PAWN, considerably expanded and changed. SOLAR LOTTERY was totally original. Likewise THE WORLD JONES MADE, THE MAN WHO JAPED, EYE IN THE SKY. THE COSMIC PUPPETS is a reprint of A GLASS OF DARKNESS. THE GAME PLAYERS OF TITAN, THE SIMULACRA, DR. BLOODMONEY were original, but I used material from the story “War Veteran” (published in If, and “The Mold of Yancy”, published in If, and “The Defenders” published in Galaxy) for THE PENULTIMATE TRUTH. You might be interested to know that THE MAN IN THE HIGH CASTLE is about to be reissued, by Berkley.
